All right. Once upon a time…

Arabic: كَانَ هُنَاكَ جَمَلٌ صَغِيرٌ فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ.
Transliteration: kaana hunaaka jamalun ṣaghiirun fi ṣ-ṣaḥraaʾ.

Hello, my darling! I missed you.
I love the sound of the rain.
Me too. Rain is a blessing.
Never mind, what matters is that you're OK.
Never mind, we'll solve it together.

Arabic: عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ يَا سَارَةُ! هٰذِهِ عِيدِيَّتُكِ.
Transliteration: ʿiidun mubaarakun yaa saaratu! haadhihi ʿiidiyyatuki.
English: Eid Mubarak, Sara! This is your Eid money.
How beautiful the roses are, Grandma!

id: sent:polite:يَا أَبِي، أَعْطِنِي قَلِيلًا مِنَ الْمَاءِ مِنْ فَضْلِكِ.

Yusuf, will you play with me? (the verb for a girl)
Please, Grandpa, sit here. (the words for a woman)
Did you wash your hands, Sara?
Did you wash your hands, Sara? (the words for a boy)
Thank you, Mum. (the "you" for a man)
Wake up, my daughter. It's seven o'clock.
No, you will be late for school.

Arabic: حَسَنًا، أَنَا أَسْتَيْقِظُ. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ يَا أُمِّي.
Transliteration: ḥasanan, ana astayqiẓ. ṣabaaḥu l-khayri yaa ummii.
English: OK, I'm getting up. Good morning, Mum.

Arabic: صَبَاحُ النُّورِ. اِغْسِلِي وَجْهَكِ وَيَدَيْكِ بِسُرْعَةٍ.
Transliteration: ṣabaaḥu n-nuur. ighsilii wajhaki wa-yadayki bi-surʿa.
English: Good morning to you. Wash your face and hands, quickly.
Yes, the eggs and bread are ready.

Arabic: هَلْ أَنْتِ جَاهِزَةٌ يَا سَارَةُ؟ سَنَخْرُجُ فِي الثَّامِنَةِ.
Transliteration: hal anti jaahizatun yaa saaratu? sa-nakhruju fi th-thaamina.
English: Are you ready, Sara? We're leaving at eight.

Arabic: نَعَمْ يَا أَبِي، أَلْبَسُ حِذَائِي الْآنَ.
Transliteration: naʿam yaa abii, albasu ḥidhaaʾi l-aan.
English: Yes, Dad, I'm putting my shoes on now.
Have you put your books in the bag?
Yes, and I put my notebook and pens in too.
Excellent. And where is the water bottle?
Oh, I forgot it! I'll get it right away.

Arabic: هَيَّا بِنَا، لَا نُرِيدُ أَنْ نَتَأَخَّرَ.
Transliteration: hayyaa binaa, laa nuriidu an nataʾakhkhar.
English: Let's go, we don't want to be late.

Arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ! لَقَدْ عُدْتُ مِنَ الْمَدْرَسَةِ.
Transliteration: as-salaamu ʿalaykum! laqad ʿudtu mina l-madrasa.
English: Peace be upon you! I'm back from school.

Arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ يَا حَبِيبَتِي. كَيْفَ كَانَ يَوْمُكِ؟
Transliteration: wa-ʿalaykumu s-salaamu yaa ḥabiibatii. kayfa kaana yawmuki?
English: And peace be upon you, my darling. How was your day?

Arabic: كَانَ جَيِّدًا. أَخَذْتُ نَجْمَةً فِي دَرْسِ الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ!
Transliteration: kaana jayyidan. akhadhtu najmatan fii darsi r-riyaaḍiyyaat!
English: It was good. I got a star in the maths lesson!

Arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ! أَنَا فَخُورَةٌ بِكِ.
Transliteration: maa shaaʾa llaah! ana fakhuuratun biki.
English: Ma sha Allah! I'm proud of you.

Arabic: اِغْسِلِي يَدَيْكِ، وَالْغَدَاءُ جَاهِزٌ بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍ.
Transliteration: ighsilii yadayki, wa-l-ghadaaʾu jaahizun baʿda qaliil.
English: Wash your hands; lunch will be ready soon.

Arabic: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ يَا سَارَةُ! هَلْ حَلَلْتِ الْوَاجِبَ؟
Transliteration: ṣabaaḥu l-khayri yaa saaratu! hal ḥalalti l-waajib?
English: Good morning, Sara! Did you do the homework?

Arabic: نَعَمْ، وَلٰكِنَّ السُّؤَالَ الْأَخِيرَ كَانَ صَعْبًا.
Transliteration: naʿam, wa-laakinna s-suʾaala l-akhiira kaana ṣaʿban.
English: Yes, but the last question was hard.

Arabic: صَحِيحٌ! هَلْ تُسَاعِدِينَنِي فِيهِ فِي الِاسْتِرَاحَةِ؟
Transliteration: ṣaḥiiḥ! hal tusaaʿidiinanii fiihi fi l-istiraaḥa?
English: True! Will you help me with it at break?
Of course. And after that we play ball.
Great idea! You're the best friend.
Yum! This is my favourite food.

Arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ. شُكْرًا لَكِ يَا أُمِّي، الطَّعَامُ لَذِيذٌ!
Transliteration: bismi llaah. shukran laki yaa ummii, aṭ-ṭaʿaamu ladhiidh!
English: Bismillah. Thank you, Mum, the food is delicious!

Arabic: أُرِيدُ كِيلُو مِنَ الطَّمَاطِمِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
Transliteration: uriidu kiiluu mina ṭ-ṭamaaṭim, min faḍlik.

English: Dad, shall we buy oranges too?
Yes. How much are the oranges?
Thank you, sir! (يَا عَمُّ, "uncle", is a polite way to speak to an older man)

Arabic: سَارَةُ، هَلْ تَأْتِينَ مَعِي إِلَى صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ؟
Transliteration: saaratu, hal taʾtiina maʿii ilaa ṣalaati l-ʿaṣr?
English: Sara, will you come with me to the afternoon prayer?
Yes, Grandpa, I'll do wudu first.
Well done. And don't forget your headscarf.
Why do we go in with the right foot?

Arabic: هٰذِهِ سُنَّةٌ. وَنَقُولُ دُعَاءَ دُخُولِ الْمَسْجِدِ.
Transliteration: haadhihi sunna. wa-naquulu duʿaaʾa dukhuuli l-masjid.
English: It's the Sunnah. And we say the prayer for entering the mosque.

Arabic: بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ، هَلْ نَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ مَعًا؟
Transliteration: baʿda ṣ-ṣalaah, hal naqraʾu l-qurʾaana maʿan?
English: After the prayer, shall we read the Quran together?
How long until the Maghrib call to prayer?

Arabic: صُمْتُ الْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ، وَأَنَا عَطْشَانَةٌ جِدًّا!
Transliteration: ṣumtu l-yawma kullahu, wa-ana ʿaṭshaanatun jiddan!
English: I fasted the whole day, and I'm so thirsty!

Arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ، أَنْتِ صَائِمَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ قَوِيَّةٌ.
Transliteration: maa shaaʾa llaah, anti ṣaaʾimatun ṣaghiiratun qawiyya.
English: Ma sha Allah, you're a strong little faster.
Bismillah. I'll start with a date.
May God accept your fast, Sara.

Arabic: جَدِّي، كَيْفَ كَانَتِ الْحَيَاةُ عِنْدَمَا كُنْتَ صَغِيرًا؟
Transliteration: jaddii, kayfa kaanati l-ḥayaatu ʿindamaa kunta ṣaghiiran?
English: Grandpa, what was life like when you were little?

Arabic: كُنَّا نَسْكُنُ فِي قَرْيَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ قُرْبَ النَّهْرِ.
Transliteration: kunnaa naskunu fii qaryatin ṣaghiiratin qurba n-nahr.
English: We lived in a small village near the river.

Arabic: لَا! كُنَّا نَلْعَبُ فِي الْحُقُولِ حَتَّى الْمَغْرِبِ.
Transliteration: laa! kunnaa nalʿabu fi l-ḥuquuli ḥatta l-maghrib.
English: No! We played in the fields until sunset.
And what did you like to eat?

Arabic: خُبْزَ جَدَّتِي الْحَارَّ مِنَ الْفُرْنِ، مَعَ الْعَسَلِ.
Transliteration: khubza jaddatii l-ḥaarra mina l-furn, maʿa l-ʿasal.
English: My grandmother's hot bread from the oven, with honey.

Arabic: يَا سَلَامُ! أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَزُورَ الْقَرْيَةَ يَوْمًا.
Transliteration: yaa salaam! uriidu an azuura l-qaryata yawman.
English: Wow! I want to visit the village one day.
Yes, Grandma, I can hear you and see you!
Ma sha Allah, you've grown so much!

Arabic: كَيْفَ حَالُكِ يَا جَدَّتِي؟ وَكَيْفَ صِحَّتُكِ؟
Transliteration: kayfa ḥaaluki yaa jaddatii? wa-kayfa ṣiḥḥatuki?
English: How are you, Grandma? And how is your health?

Arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ. مَتَى تَزُورِينَنَا؟
Transliteration: al-ḥamdu lillaah, ana bi-khayr. mataa tazuuriinanaa?
English: Praise be to God, I am well. When will you visit us?

Arabic: فِي الْعُطْلَةِ الصَّيْفِيَّةِ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.
Transliteration: fi l-ʿuṭlati ṣ-ṣayfiyya, in shaaʾa llaah.
English: In the summer holiday, God willing.
I will bake you the biscuits you love.
Sara, will you play hide and seek with us?

Arabic: أَنَا أَعُدُّ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ، وَأَنْتِ تَخْتَبِئِينَ.
Transliteration: ana aʿuddu ilaa ʿishriin, wa-anti takhtabiʾiin.
English: I'll count to twenty, and you hide.

Arabic: …ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ، تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ، عِشْرُونَ! أَنَا قَادِمٌ!
Transliteration: …thamaaniyata ʿashar, tisʿata ʿashar, ʿishruun! ana qaadim!

English: Mum! The sky is full of clouds.

Arabic: نَعَمْ، سَتُمْطِرُ قَرِيبًا. أَدْخِلِي الْغَسِيلَ مِنْ فَضْلِكِ.
Transliteration: naʿam, sa-tumṭiru qariiban. adkhilii l-ghasiila min faḍliki.
English: Yes, it will rain soon. Bring the washing in, please.

Arabic: لَا تَخَافِي. نَقُولُ: اللّٰهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا.
Transliteration: laa takhaafii. naquulu: allaahumma ṣayyiban naafiʿan.
English: Don't be scared. We say: O God, let it be a helpful rain.

Arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا. هَلْ أَلْعَبُ فِي الْمَطَرِ قَلِيلًا؟
Transliteration: allaahumma ṣayyiban naafiʿan. hal alʿabu fi l-maṭari qaliilan?
English: O God, let it be a helpful rain. Can I play in the rain a little?
Just a little, then you change your clothes.

Arabic: أَوْقَعْتُ الْمَاءَ عَلَى رَسْمَتِكِ بِدُونِ قَصْدٍ.
Transliteration: awqaʿtu l-maaʾa ʿalaa rasmatiki bi-duuni qaṣd.
English: I spilled water on your drawing by accident.
Oh… it was a beautiful drawing.

Arabic: أَعْرِفُ. هَلْ نَرْسُمُ وَاحِدَةً جَدِيدَةً مَعًا؟
Transliteration: aʿrifu. hal narsumu waaḥidatan jadiidatan maʿan?
English: I know. Shall we draw a new one together?
Lovely idea. I forgive you, Sara.

Arabic: شُكْرًا لَكِ يَا لَيْلَى. أَنْتِ صَدِيقَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ.
Transliteration: shukran laki yaa laylaa. anti ṣadiiqatun ṭayyiba.
English: Thank you, Layla. You're a kind friend.

Arabic: سَارَةُ، السَّاعَةُ التَّاسِعَةُ. هَلْ نَظَّفْتِ أَسْنَانَكِ؟
Transliteration: saaratu, as-saaʿatu t-taasiʿa. hal naẓẓafti asnaanaki?
English: Sara, it's nine o'clock. Have you brushed your teeth?

Arabic: نَعَمْ يَا أَبِي. هَلْ تَقْرَأُ لِي قِصَّةً؟
Transliteration: naʿam yaa abii. hal taqraʾu lii qiṣṣa?
English: Yes, Dad. Will you read me a story?
Thank you, Dad. I love you!

Arabic: وَأَنَا أُحِبُّكِ. لَا تَنْسَيْ دُعَاءَ النَّوْمِ.
Transliteration: wa-ana uḥibbuki. laa tansay duʿaaʾa n-nawm.
English: And I love you. Don't forget the bedtime prayer.
In Your name, O God, I die and I live.
Sara, come and drink your milk.

Arabic: لَا أُحِبُّ الْحَلِيبَ يَا أُمِّي. هَلْ أَشْرَبُ عَصِيرًا؟
Transliteration: laa uḥibbu l-ḥaliiba yaa ummii. hal ashrabu ʿaṣiiran?
English: I don't like milk, Mum. Can I drink juice?

Arabic: الْحَلِيبُ مُفِيدٌ لِعِظَامِكِ. اِشْرَبِي نِصْفَ الْكُوبِ فَقَطْ.
Transliteration: al-ḥaliibu mufiidun li-ʿiẓaamiki. ishrabii niṣfa l-kuubi faqaṭ.
English: Milk is good for your bones. Just drink half the cup.

Arabic: حَسَنًا. وَمَاذَا وَضَعْتِ فِي عُلْبَةِ الْغَدَاءِ؟
Transliteration: ḥasanan. wa-maadhaa waḍaʿti fii ʿulbati l-ghadaaʾ?
English: OK. And what did you put in my lunchbox?
A cheese sandwich, a cucumber and some dates.
Yum! I'll give Layla a date.
How kind you are! Don't forget the box.

Arabic: هَلْ عِنْدَكِ وَاجِبٌ الْيَوْمَ يَا سَارَةُ؟
Transliteration: hal ʿindaki waajibun al-yawma yaa saaratu?
English: Do you have homework today, Sara?
Yes, I have reading and maths.
Start with the maths, then we'll read together.
Dad, how do I solve this problem?
Ah, I get it! The answer is ten.
Sara, will you help me in the kitchen?
Of course! What shall I do?
Wash the tomatoes and cucumbers for the salad.
I washed them. Shall I cut them too?

Arabic: لَا، السِّكِّينُ حَادَّةٌ. أَنَا أُقَطِّعُ، وَأَنْتِ تَخْلِطِينَ.
Transliteration: laa, as-sikkiinu ḥaadda. ana uqaṭṭiʿu, wa-anti takhliṭiin.
English: No, the knife is sharp. I'll cut, and you mix.
Shall I add the salt and lemon?

Arabic: نَعَمْ، قَلِيلًا مِنَ الْمِلْحِ. أَنْتِ طَبَّاخَةٌ مَاهِرَةٌ!
Transliteration: naʿam, qaliilan mina l-milḥ. anti ṭabbaakhatun maahira!
English: Yes, a little salt. You're a skilled cook!
Peace be upon you! Eid Mubarak!

Arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ يَا عَمِّي! تَقَبَّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ.
Transliteration: wa-ʿalaykumu s-salaamu yaa ʿammii! taqabbala llaahu minnaa wa-minkum.
English: And peace be upon you, Uncle! May God accept it from us and from you.

Arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ، فُسْتَانُكِ الْجَدِيدُ جَمِيلٌ!
Transliteration: maa shaaʾa llaah, fustaanuki l-jadiidu jamiil!
English: Ma sha Allah, your new dress is lovely!

Arabic: شُكْرًا لَكَ! اِشْتَرَتْهُ أُمِّي مِنَ السُّوقِ.
Transliteration: shukran laka! ishtarathu ummii mina s-suuq.
English: Thank you! Mum bought it at the market.
And this is your Eid money. What will you buy with it?
I'll buy a book, and give some to the poor.

Arabic: سَارَةُ، هَلْ تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَزْرَعِي شَجَرَةً مَعِي؟
Transliteration: saaratu, hal turiidiina an tazraʿii shajaratan maʿii?
English: Sara, would you like to plant a tree with me?
A little lemon tree. Dig here.
I've dug it! Shall I put it in now?
Yes, gently. Then we water it.

Arabic: بَعْدَ سَنَةٍ أَوْ سَنَتَيْنِ. الصَّبْرُ جَمِيلٌ!
Transliteration: baʿda sanatin aw sanatayn. aṣ-ṣabru jamiil!
English: In a year or two. Patience is beautiful!

Section: Family · A Day at the Beach (8–12)
Family · A Day at the Beach (8–12)
Arabic: بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍ. أَوَّلًا ضَعِي كِرِيمَ الشَّمْسِ.
Transliteration: baʿda qaliil. awwalan ḍaʿii kriima sh-shams.
English: In a little while. First put on sun cream.

Section: Family · A Day at the Beach (8–12)
English: I've put it on. Look, there's a big ship!

Section: Family · A Day at the Beach (8–12)
Arabic: نَعَمْ، وَهُنَاكَ صَيَّادُونَ فِي قَارِبٍ صَغِيرٍ.
Transliteration: naʿam, wa-hunaaka ṣayyaaduuna fii qaaribin ṣaghiir.
English: Yes, and there are fishermen in a small boat.

Section: Family · A Day at the Beach (8–12)
English: Shall we have fish for lunch?

Section: Family · A Day at the Beach (8–12)
Arabic: فِكْرَةٌ رَائِعَةٌ! لٰكِنْ لَا تَبْتَعِدِي عَنِ الشَّاطِئِ.
Transliteration: fikratun raaʾiʿa! laakin laa tabtaʿidii ʿani sh-shaaṭiʾ.
English: Great idea! But don't go far from the shore.

Section: Family · A Day at the Beach (8–12)

Arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا دُكْتُورُ. اِبْنَتِي مَرِيضَةٌ.
Transliteration: as-salaamu ʿalaykum yaa duktuur. ibnatii mariiḍa.
English: Peace be upon you, doctor. My daughter is ill.

Arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ. مَا بِكِ يَا سَارَةُ؟
Transliteration: wa-ʿalaykumu s-salaam. maa biki yaa saaratu?
English: And peace be upon you. What's wrong, Sara?
I have a temperature, and my head hurts.

Arabic: إِنَّهُ زُكَامٌ بَسِيطٌ. اِشْرَبِي السَّوَائِلَ وَنَامِي جَيِّدًا.
Transliteration: innahu zukaamun basiiṭ. ishrabi s-sawaaʾila wa-naamii jayyidan.
English: It's just a cold. Drink plenty and sleep well.
Sara, the bath water is ready.

Arabic: هَلِ الْمَاءُ سَاخِنٌ جِدًّا يَا أُمِّي؟
Transliteration: hali l-maaʾu saakhinun jiddan yaa ummii?
English: Is the water very hot, Mum?
No, it's warm. Test it with your hand.
Yes, it's nice. Where's the shampoo?

Arabic: عَلَى الرَّفِّ. لَا تَضَعِيهِ فِي عَيْنَيْكِ.
Transliteration: ʿala r-raff. laa taḍaʿiihi fii ʿaynayki.
English: On the shelf. Don't get it in your eyes.
I'm done! Pass me the towel, please.
Here you are. Now put on your pyjamas.

Arabic: بَرْدٌ! لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ مِنَ السَّرِيرِ.
Transliteration: bard! laa uriidu an akhruja mina s-sariir.
English: Brr, it's cold! I don't want to get out of bed.

Arabic: الْيَوْمُ بَارِدٌ فِعْلًا. اِلْبَسِي الْكَنْزَةَ الصُّوفِيَّةَ.
Transliteration: al-yawmu baaridun fiʿlan. ilbasi l-kanzata ṣ-ṣuufiyya.
English: It really is cold today. Put on the woolly jumper.

Arabic: نَعَمْ، وَالْوِشَاحَ. هَلْ تُرِيدِينَ حَلِيبًا سَاخِنًا؟
Transliteration: naʿam, wa-l-wishaaḥ. hal turiidiina ḥaliiban saakhinan?
English: Yes, and the scarf. Would you like some hot milk?
Here you are. Drink it before it gets cold.

Arabic: لَا تَنْسَيْ عُلْبَةَ الطَّعَامِ يَا سَارَةُ.
Transliteration: laa tansay ʿulbata ṭ-ṭaʿaami yaa saaratu.
English: Don't forget your lunch box, Sara.
What did you put in it today?
Zaatar bread, cucumber and some dates.

Arabic: رَائِعٌ! هَلْ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ آخُذَ عَصِيرًا أَيْضًا؟
Transliteration: raaʾiʿ! hal astaṭiiʿu an aakhudha ʿaṣiiran ayḍan?
English: Great! Can I take some juice too?

Arabic: الْمَاءُ أَفْضَلُ، لٰكِنْ خُذِي عَصِيرًا صَغِيرًا.
Transliteration: al-maaʾu afḍal, laakin khudhii ʿaṣiiran ṣaghiiran.
English: Water is better, but take a small juice.
I'll share the dates with Layla.

Arabic: سَارَةُ، السَّاعَةُ الثَّامِنَةُ إِلَّا رُبْعًا! سَتَفُوتُنَا الْحَافِلَةُ.
Transliteration: saaratu, as-saaʿatu th-thaaminatu illaa rubʿan! sa-tafuutuna l-ḥaafila.
English: Sara, it's quarter to eight! We'll miss the bus.

Arabic: آسِفَةٌ يَا أَبِي، لَمْ يَرِنَّ الْمُنَبِّهُ.
Transliteration: aasifatun yaa abii, lam yarinna l-munabbih.
English: Sorry, Dad, the alarm didn't go off.

Arabic: لَا بَأْسَ. اِلْبَسِي بِسُرْعَةٍ، وَخُذِي الْفُطُورَ مَعَكِ.
Transliteration: laa baʾs. ilbasii bi-surʿa, wa-khudhi l-fuṭuura maʿaki.
English: Never mind. Get dressed quickly and take your breakfast with you.
Look under the chair in the living room.
Come on. And tomorrow we go to bed early, agreed?

Arabic: سَارَةُ، مَا هٰذِهِ الْفَوْضَى فِي غُرْفَتِكِ؟
Transliteration: saaratu, maa haadhihi l-fawḍaa fii ghurfatiki?
English: Sara, what's this mess in your room?
I was playing with my dolls.

Arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، لٰكِنْ يَجِبُ أَنْ تُرَتِّبِيهَا الْآنَ.
Transliteration: laa baʾs, laakin yajibu an turattibiiha l-aan.
English: That's fine, but you have to tidy it now.

Arabic: أَنْتِ تَجْمَعِينَ الْأَلْعَابَ، وَأَنَا أُرَتِّبُ السَّرِيرَ.
Transliteration: anti tajmaʿiina l-alʿaab, wa-ana urattibu s-sariir.
English: You pick up the toys, and I'll make the bed.
And I'll put the books on the shelf.

Arabic: مَا أَجْمَلَ الْغُرْفَةَ الْآنَ! شُكْرًا يَا سَارَةُ.
Transliteration: maa ajmala l-ghurfata l-aan! shukran yaa saaratu.
English: How nice the room looks now! Thank you, Sara.
Dad, we got our report cards today.

Arabic: أَرِينِي! مُمْتَازٌ فِي الْعَرَبِيَّةِ وَالْعُلُومِ، مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ!
Transliteration: ariinii! mumtaazun fi l-ʿarabiyyati wa-l-ʿuluum, maa shaaʾa llaah!
English: Show me! Excellent in Arabic and science, ma sha Allah!
But my mark in maths is only average.
Don't be sad. What's hard about it?
Fractions. I don't understand them well.
We'll practise them together every evening.

Arabic: شُكْرًا يَا أَبِي، أَنْتَ أَفْضَلُ مُعَلِّمٍ!
Transliteration: shukran yaa abii, anta afḍalu muʿallim!
English: Thank you, Dad, you're the best teacher!

Arabic: أُمِّي، غَدًا امْتِحَانُ الْعُلُومِ وَأَنَا قَلِقَةٌ.
Transliteration: ummii, ghadan imtiḥaanu l-ʿuluumi wa-ana qaliqa.
English: Mum, the science test is tomorrow and I'm worried.

Arabic: رَاجَعْتُ دَرْسَ النَّبَاتَاتِ، وَبَقِيَ دَرْسُ الْمَاءِ.
Transliteration: raajaʿtu darsa n-nabaataat, wa-baqiya darsu l-maaʾ.
English: I've revised the plants lesson; the water one is left.

Arabic: هَيَّا نُرَاجِعْهُ مَعًا. مِنْ أَيْنَ يَأْتِي الْمَطَرُ؟
Transliteration: hayyaa nuraajiʿhu maʿan. min ayna yaʾti l-maṭar?
English: Let's revise it together. Where does rain come from?
From the water vapour in the clouds!

Arabic: صَحِيحٌ! أَنْتِ مُسْتَعِدَّةٌ. نَامِي مُبَكِّرًا هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ.
Transliteration: ṣaḥiiḥ! anti mustaʿidda. naamii mubakkiran haadhihi l-layla.
English: Right! You're ready. Go to sleep early tonight.

Arabic: إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ. شُكْرًا يَا أُمِّي.
Transliteration: in shaaʾa llaah. shukran yaa ummii.

Arabic: أَبِي، هَلْ سَتَأْتِي إِلَى يَوْمِ الرِّيَاضَةِ؟
Transliteration: abii, hal sa-taʾtii ilaa yawmi r-riyaaḍa?
English: Dad, are you coming to sports day?
Of course! Which race are you in?

Arabic: سِبَاقُ مِئَةِ مِتْرٍ، وَسِبَاقُ الْبَيْضَةِ وَالْمِلْعَقَةِ.
Transliteration: sibaaqu miʾati mitr, wa-sibaaqu l-bayḍati wa-l-milʿaqa.
English: The hundred metres, and the egg-and-spoon race.
Dad! I came second in the race!
It fell… but we laughed a lot!
This is the city library. Speak quietly.
How many books can I borrow?

Arabic: سَآخُذُ قِصَّةً، وَكِتَابًا عَنِ الْفَضَاءِ، وَكِتَابَ شِعْرٍ.
Transliteration: sa-aakhudhu qiṣṣatan, wa-kitaaban ʿani l-faḍaaʾ, wa-kitaaba shiʿr.
English: I'll take a story, a book about space and a poetry book.
Great choice. And I'll take a novel.
Shall we read together before bed?

Arabic: سَارَةُ، هَلْ تُسَاعِدِينَنِي فِي تَحْضِيرِ الْمَائِدَةِ؟
Transliteration: saaratu, hal tusaaʿidiinanii fii taḥḍiiri l-maaʾida?
English: Sara, will you help me lay the table?
Of course. How many plates shall I put out?
Six. Your grandpa and grandma are coming.
And I put the glasses next to the plates.
Well done. And the bread goes in the basket.
Dad, the table is ready! Come.

Arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ، مَائِدَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ! شُكْرًا يَا سَارَةُ.
Transliteration: maa shaaʾa llaah, maaʾidatun jamiila! shukran yaa saaratu.
English: Ma sha Allah, a lovely table! Thank you, Sara.
Look what I bought at the souq!

Arabic: الصَّيْفُ مَوْسِمُ الْبِطِّيخِ. سَنَأْكُلُهَا بَعْدَ الْغَدَاءِ.
Transliteration: aṣ-ṣayfu mawsimu l-biṭṭiikh. sa-naʾkuluhaa baʿda l-ghadaaʾ.
English: Summer is watermelon season. We'll eat it after lunch.

Arabic: جَدِّي يَأْكُلُ الْبِطِّيخَ مَعَ الْجُبْنِ الْأَبْيَضِ!
Transliteration: jaddii yaʾkulu l-biṭṭiikha maʿa l-jubni l-abyaḍ!
English: Grandpa eats watermelon with white cheese!

Arabic: نَعَمْ، هٰذَا مَشْهُورٌ فِي بِلَادِ الشَّامِ. هَلْ تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تُجَرِّبِيهِ؟
Transliteration: naʿam, haadhaa mash-huurun fii bilaadi sh-shaam. hal turiidiina an tujarribiih?
English: Yes, people love it in the Levant. Do you want to try it?
Yes! But I don't like the seeds.

Arabic: سَأُعْطِيكِ قِطْعَةً مِنَ الْوَسَطِ بِدُونِ بُذُورٍ.
Transliteration: sa-uʿṭiiki qiṭʿatan mina l-wasaṭi bi-duuni budhuur.
English: I'll give you a piece from the middle with no seeds.

Arabic: كُلُّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتِ بِخَيْرٍ يَا سَارَةُ!
Transliteration: kullu ʿaamin wa-anti bi-khayr yaa saaratu!

Arabic: وَأَنْتَ بِخَيْرٍ يَا يُوسُفُ! شُكْرًا لِأَنَّكَ جِئْتَ.
Transliteration: wa-anta bi-khayr yaa yuusuf! shukran li-annaka jiʾt.
English: And to you, Yusuf! Thanks for coming.
This is your present. Open it!

Arabic: كِتَابُ رَسْمٍ وَأَلْوَانٌ! أُحِبُّ الرَّسْمَ كَثِيرًا.
Transliteration: kitaabu rasmin wa-alwaan! uḥibbu r-rasma kathiiran.
English: A drawing book and colours! I love drawing.
Come on, children, it's cake time!
Sara, make a wish and blow out the candles!

Arabic: سَارَةُ، صَنَعْتُ لَكِ شُورْبَةَ الْعَدَسِ الَّتِي تُحِبِّينَهَا.
Transliteration: saaratu, ṣanaʿtu laki shuurbata l-ʿadasi llatii tuḥibbiinahaa.
English: Sara, I made you the lentil soup you love.
Thank you, Grandma! How do you make it?

Arabic: عَدَسٌ أَحْمَرُ، وَبَصَلٌ، وَجَزَرٌ، وَقَلِيلٌ مِنَ الْكَمُّونِ.
Transliteration: ʿadasun aḥmar, wa-baṣal, wa-jazar, wa-qaliilun mina l-kammuun.
English: Red lentils, onion, carrot and a little cumin.

Arabic: نَعَمْ، نَعْصِرُ اللَّيْمُونَ فِي الْآخِرِ، وَنَأْكُلُهَا مَعَ الْخُبْزِ الْمُحَمَّصِ.
Transliteration: naʿam, naʿṣiru l-laymuuna fi l-aakhir, wa-naʾkuluhaa maʿa l-khubzi l-muḥammaṣ.
English: Yes, we squeeze in the lemon at the end, and eat it with toasted bread.
Teach me to make it, Grandma.

Arabic: اِسْتَيْقِظِي يَا سَارَةُ، هٰذَا أَذَانُ الْفَجْرِ.
Transliteration: istayqiẓii yaa saaratu, haadhaa adhaanu l-fajr.
English: Wake up, Sara, that's the call to Fajr.

Arabic: لٰكِنَّ الدُّنْيَا مَا زَالَتْ مُظْلِمَةً يَا أَبِي.
Transliteration: laakinna d-dunyaa maa zaalat muẓlimatan yaa abii.

Arabic: نَعَمْ، الْفَجْرُ قَبْلَ شُرُوقِ الشَّمْسِ. "الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ".
Transliteration: naʿam, al-fajru qabla shuruuqi sh-shams. "aṣ-ṣalaatu khayrun mina n-nawm".
English: Yes, Fajr is before sunrise. "Prayer is better than sleep."

Arabic: أَعْرِفُ هٰذِهِ الْجُمْلَةَ! نَسْمَعُهَا فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ فَقَطْ.
Transliteration: aʿrifu haadhihi l-jumla! nasmaʿuhaa fii adhaani l-fajri faqaṭ.
English: I know that line! We only hear it in the call to Fajr.

Arabic: بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ، هَلْ أَعُودُ إِلَى النَّوْمِ؟
Transliteration: baʿda ṣ-ṣalaah, hal aʿuudu ila n-nawm?
English: After the prayer, can I go back to sleep?
Yes, for one hour before school.

Arabic: الْيَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةُ. اِغْتَسِلِي وَالْبَسِي ثِيَابًا نَظِيفَةً.
Transliteration: al-yawma l-jumuʿa. ightasilii wa-lbasii thiyaaban naẓiifa.
English: It's Friday. Have a wash and put on clean clothes.
Are we all going to the mosque?

Arabic: نَعَمْ، وَنَجْلِسُ أَنَا وَأَنْتِ فِي مُصَلَّى النِّسَاءِ.
Transliteration: naʿam, wa-najlisu ana wa-anti fii muṣallaa n-nisaaʾ.
English: Yes, and you and I sit in the women's prayer hall.
And Dad listens to the sermon at the front?

Arabic: نَعَمْ. وَالْخُطْبَةُ الْيَوْمَ عَنْ بِرِّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ.
Transliteration: naʿam. wa-l-khuṭbatu l-yawma ʿan birri l-waalidayn.
English: Yes. And today's sermon is about being good to your parents.
And after the prayer we'll visit your grandpa.
Sara, can you hear the call to prayer?

Arabic: نَعَمْ يَا جَدِّي، إِنَّهُ أَذَانُ الْمَغْرِبِ.
Transliteration: naʿam yaa jaddii, innahu adhaanu l-maghrib.
English: Yes, Grandpa, it's the call to Maghrib.
How many rakʿas are there in Maghrib?
Well done. Where is the prayer mat?

Arabic: هَا هِيَ. هَلْ تَؤُمُّنَا يَا جَدِّي؟
Transliteration: haa hiya. hal taʾummunaa yaa jaddii?
English: Here it is. Will you lead us, Grandpa?
Yes. Stand next to your grandma.

Arabic: هَيَّا يَا سَارَةُ، وَقْتُ دَرْسِ الْقُرْآنِ.
Transliteration: hayyaa yaa saaratu, waqtu darsi l-qurʾaan.
English: Come on, Sara, it's time for the Quran lesson.
I've learned al-Fatiha by heart, Grandma!
Ma sha Allah! Recite it for me.
"Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds…"
Which sura will I learn next?

Arabic: جَدِّي، مَاذَا تَقُولُ عِنْدَمَا تَرْكَبُ السَّيَّارَةَ؟
Transliteration: jaddii, maadhaa taquulu ʿindamaa tarkabu s-sayyaara?
English: Grandpa, what do you say when you get in the car?

Arabic: أَقُولُ دُعَاءَ السَّفَرِ: "سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا".
Transliteration: aquulu duʿaaʾa s-safar: "subḥaana lladhii sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa".
English: I say the travel dua: "Glory be to Him who has placed this at our service."
And what do we say before we sleep?
"In Your name, O God, I die and I live."
That's a short dua. I'll learn it.
And you can pray in your own words too.

Arabic: إِذَنْ سَأَدْعُو لَكَ وَلِجَدَّتِي كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ.
Transliteration: idhan sa-adʿuu laka wa-li-jaddatii kulla layla.
English: Then I'll pray for you and Grandma every night.

Arabic: أَبِي، مَنْ هٰذَا الرَّجُلُ أَمَامَ الْمَسْجِدِ؟
Transliteration: abii, man haadha r-rajulu amaama l-masjid?
English: Dad, who is that man in front of the mosque?

Arabic: إِنَّهُ مُحْتَاجٌ. هَلْ تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُ صَدَقَةً؟
Transliteration: innahu muḥtaaj. hal turiidiina an tuʿṭiyahu ṣadaqa?
English: He is in need. Would you like to give him some charity?

Arabic: نَعَمْ! عِنْدِي عَشَرَةُ دَرَاهِمَ مِنْ مَصْرُوفِي.
Transliteration: naʿam! ʿindii ʿasharatu daraahima min maṣruufii.
English: Yes! I have ten dirhams of my pocket money.
What a kind heart you have! Give it with a smile.

Arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ: "تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ صَدَقَةٌ".
Transliteration: qaala n-nabiyy: "tabassumuka fii wajhi akhiika ṣadaqa".
English: The Prophet said: "Your smile to your brother is charity."

Arabic: إِذَنْ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَتَصَدَّقَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ!
Transliteration: idhan astaṭiiʿu an ataṣaddaqa kulla yawm!
English: So I can give charity every day!

Arabic: سَارَةُ، السَّاعَةُ الثَّالِثَةُ وَالنِّصْفُ. هَيَّا إِلَى السُّحُورِ.
Transliteration: saaratu, as-saaʿatu th-thaalithatu wa-n-niṣf. hayyaa ila s-suḥuur.
English: Sara, it's half past three. Come for suhoor.
Am I going to fast tomorrow, Mum?

Arabic: نِصْفَ يَوْمٍ، حَتَّى الظُّهْرِ. أَنْتِ مَا زِلْتِ صَغِيرَةً.
Transliteration: niṣfa yawm, ḥatta ẓ-ẓuhr. anti maa zilti ṣaghiira.
English: Half a day, until noon. You're still little.

Arabic: لٰكِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَصُومَ يَوْمًا كَامِلًا مِثْلَكِ!
Transliteration: laakinnii uriidu an aṣuuma yawman kaamilan mithlaki!
English: But I want to fast a whole day like you!

Arabic: فِي الْعَامِ الْقَادِمِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ. كُلِي الْآنَ وَاشْرَبِي مَاءً كَثِيرًا.
Transliteration: fi l-ʿaami l-qaadimi in shaaʾa llaah. kulii l-aana wa-shrabii maaʾan kathiiran.
English: Next year, God willing. Eat now and drink plenty of water.

Arabic: أَسْرِعُوا، بَقِيَتْ عَشْرُ دَقَائِقَ عَلَى الْأَذَانِ.
Transliteration: asriʿuu, baqiyat ʿashru daqaaʾiqa ʿala l-adhaan.
English: Hurry, everyone: ten minutes until the call to prayer.
I'll drink one more glass of water.

Arabic: بَقِيَ أُسْبُوعٌ عَلَى الْعِيدِ. هَيَّا نَشْتَرِ مَلَابِسَ الْعِيدِ.
Transliteration: baqiya usbuuʿun ʿala l-ʿiid. hayyaa nashtari malaabisa l-ʿiid.
English: Eid is a week away. Let's buy Eid clothes.
Wonderful! I want a green dress.

Arabic: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا. عِنْدَنَا فَسَاتِينُ جَمِيلَةٌ. مَا مَقَاسُكِ؟
Transliteration: ahlan wa-sahlan. ʿindanaa fasaatiinu jamiila. maa maqaasuki?
English: Welcome. We have lovely dresses. What size are you?
It fits perfectly! How much is it?
A hundred and twenty, and there's an Eid discount for you.

Arabic: سَارَةُ، هَلْ رَأَيْتِ نَظَّارَتِي؟ لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ الْجَرِيدَةَ.
Transliteration: saaratu, hal raʾayti naẓẓaaratii? laa astaṭiiʿu an aqraʾa l-jariida.
English: Sara, have you seen my glasses? I can't read the newspaper.

Arabic: سَأَبْحَثُ عَنْهَا. هَلْ هِيَ فِي الْمَطْبَخِ؟
Transliteration: sa-abḥathu ʿanhaa. hal hiya fi l-maṭbakh?
English: I'll look for them. Are they in the kitchen?

Arabic: لَا أَظُنُّ. كُنْتُ جَالِسًا هُنَا عَلَى الْكَنَبَةِ.
Transliteration: laa aẓunn. kuntu jaalisan hunaa ʿala l-kanaba.
English: I don't think so. I was sitting here on the sofa.

Arabic: لَيْسَتْ تَحْتَ الْوِسَادَةِ… جَدِّي! اُنْظُرْ فِي الْمِرْآةِ!
Transliteration: laysat taḥta l-wisaada… jaddii! unẓur fi l-mirʾaa!
English: They're not under the cushion… Grandpa! Look in the mirror!

Arabic: هَا هَا! كَانَتْ عَلَى رَأْسِي طُولَ الْوَقْتِ!
Transliteration: haa haa! kaanat ʿalaa raʾsii ṭuula l-waqt!
English: Ha ha! They were on my head the whole time!

Arabic: أَنْتَ تَنْسَاهَا هُنَاكَ دَائِمًا يَا جَدِّي.
Transliteration: anta tansaahaa hunaaka daaʾiman yaa jaddii.
English: You always forget them up there, Grandpa.
That's why I need a clever granddaughter like you.

Arabic: سَنَعْبُرُ الشَّارِعَ إِلَى الْحَدِيقَةِ. أَمْسِكِي يَدِي جَيِّدًا.
Transliteration: sa-naʿburu sh-shaariʿa ila l-ḥadiiqa. amsikii yadii jayyidan.
English: We'll cross the road to the park. Hold my hand tightly.
Grandpa, the light is red for people walking.
Well done. We stand on the pavement and wait.

Arabic: لِمَاذَا لَا نَعْبُرُ؟ لَا تُوجَدُ سَيَّارَاتٌ.
Transliteration: li-maadhaa laa naʿbur? laa tuujadu sayyaaraat.
English: Why don't we cross? There aren't any cars.

Arabic: قَدْ تَأْتِي سَيَّارَةٌ فَجْأَةً. السَّلَامَةُ أَوَّلًا.
Transliteration: qad taʾtii sayyaaratun fajʾatan. as-salaamatu awwalan.
English: A car might come suddenly. Safety first.

Arabic: صَارَتْ خَضْرَاءَ! نَنْظُرُ يَمِينًا وَيَسَارًا، ثُمَّ نَعْبُرُ.
Transliteration: ṣaarat khaḍraaʾ! nanẓuru yamiinan wa-yasaaran, thumma naʿbur.
English: It's gone green! We look right and left, then cross.

Arabic: أَهْلًا بِكِ فِي الْقَرْيَةِ يَا سَارَةُ! هٰذَا بَيْتِي الْقَدِيمُ.
Transliteration: ahlan biki fi l-qaryati yaa saaratu! haadhaa baytii l-qadiim.
English: Welcome to the village, Sara! This is my old house.

Arabic: نَعَمْ، وَكُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ تَحْتَ هٰذِهِ النَّخْلَةِ وَأَنَا صَغِيرٌ.
Transliteration: naʿam, wa-kuntu alʿabu taḥta haadhihi n-nakhlati wa-ana ṣaghiir.
English: Yes, and I used to play under this palm tree when I was little.

Arabic: هَلْ كَانَتْ هُنَاكَ مَدْرَسَةٌ فِي الْقَرْيَةِ؟
Transliteration: hal kaanat hunaaka madrasatun fi l-qarya?
English: Was there a school in the village?

Arabic: كَانَ عِنْدَنَا كُتَّابٌ صَغِيرٌ، وَكُنَّا نَكْتُبُ عَلَى أَلْوَاحٍ.
Transliteration: kaana ʿindanaa kuttaabun ṣaghiir, wa-kunnaa naktubu ʿalaa alwaaḥ.
English: We had a little Quran school, and we wrote on wooden boards.
With no computer and no phone?

Arabic: لَا شَيْءَ! لٰكِنْ كَانَتْ عِنْدَنَا السَّمَاءُ وَالنُّجُومُ وَالْأَصْدِقَاءُ.
Transliteration: laa shayʾ! laakin kaanat ʿindana s-samaaʾu wa-n-nujuumu wa-l-aṣdiqaaʾ.
English: Nothing! But we had the sky, the stars and our friends.

Arabic: هٰذَا سَرِيرُكِ يَا سَارَةُ. هَلْ أَحْضَرْتِ مَلَابِسَ النَّوْمِ؟
Transliteration: haadhaa sariiruki yaa saaratu. hal aḥḍarti malaabisa n-nawm?
English: This is your bed, Sara. Did you bring your pyjamas?
Yes, and I brought my little teddy bear too.

Arabic: هَلْ تُرِيدِينَ حَلِيبًا بِالْهَيْلِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ؟
Transliteration: hal turiidiina ḥaliiban bi-l-hayli qabla n-nawm?
English: Would you like some milk with cardamom before bed?

Arabic: نَعَمْ مِنْ فَضْلِكِ. وَهَلْ تَحْكِينَ لِي قِصَّةً؟
Transliteration: naʿam min faḍliki. wa-hal taḥkiina lii qiṣṣa?
English: Yes please. And will you tell me a story?
I'll tell you the story of Juha and the donkey.

Arabic: أُحِبُّ قِصَصَ جُحَا! إِنَّهَا مُضْحِكَةٌ جِدًّا.
Transliteration: uḥibbu qiṣaṣa juḥaa! innahaa muḍḥikatun jiddan.
English: I love Juha stories! They're so funny.

Arabic: سَارَةُ، صَنَعْتُ لَكِ طَائِرَةً وَرَقِيَّةً مِنَ الْقَصَبِ وَالْوَرَقِ.
Transliteration: saaratu, ṣanaʿtu laki ṭaaʾiratan waraqiyyatan mina l-qaṣabi wa-l-waraq.
English: Sara, I made you a kite out of cane and paper.

Arabic: مَا أَجْمَلَهَا يَا عَمِّي! أَلْوَانُهَا رَائِعَةٌ.
Transliteration: maa ajmalahaa yaa ʿammii! alwaanuhaa raaʾiʿa.
English: It's beautiful, Uncle! Its colours are wonderful.

Arabic: لِنَصْعَدْ إِلَى السَّطْحِ. الرِّيحُ هُنَاكَ أَقْوَى.
Transliteration: li-naṣʿad ila s-saṭḥ. ar-riiḥu hunaaka aqwaa.
English: Let's go up to the roof. The wind is stronger there.

Arabic: أَمْسِكِي الْخَيْطَ، وَاجْرِي قَلِيلًا عَكْسَ الرِّيحِ.
Transliteration: amsikii l-khayṭ, wa-jrii qaliilan ʿaksa r-riiḥ.
English: Hold the string, and run a little into the wind.

Arabic: إِنَّهَا تَطِيرُ! اُنْظُرْ يَا عَمِّي، إِنَّهَا فَوْقَ الْبُيُوتِ!
Transliteration: innahaa taṭiir! unẓur yaa ʿammii, innahaa fawqa l-buyuut!
English: It's flying! Look, Uncle, it's above the houses!

Arabic: لَا تُرْخِي الْخَيْطَ كَثِيرًا، وَإِلَّا سَتَهْرُبُ!
Transliteration: laa turkhii l-khayṭa kathiiran, wa-illaa sa-tahrub!
English: Don't let out too much string, or it'll get away!

Arabic: سَارَةُ، يَنْقُصُنَا لَاعِبٌ. هَلْ تَلْعَبِينَ مَعَنَا؟
Transliteration: saaratu, yanquṣunaa laaʿib. hal talʿabiina maʿanaa?
English: Sara, we're one player short. Will you play with us?

Arabic: بِكُلِّ سُرُورٍ! فِي أَيِّ فَرِيقٍ أَنَا؟
Transliteration: bi-kulli suruur! fii ayyi fariiqin ana?
English: With pleasure! Which team am I on?

Arabic: مَعِي وَمَعَ لَيْلَى. نَحْنُ الْفَرِيقُ الْأَزْرَقُ.
Transliteration: maʿii wa-maʿa laylaa. naḥnu l-fariiqu l-azraq.
English: With me and Layla. We're the blue team.
Sara, pass the ball to me!
Well done, you two! Sara, your pass was excellent.

Arabic: وَصَلْنَا إِلَى الْحَدِيقَةِ. بِمَاذَا تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَلْعَبِي أَوَّلًا؟
Transliteration: waṣalnaa ila l-ḥadiiqa. bi-maadhaa turiidiina an talʿabii awwalan?
English: We're at the park. What do you want to play on first?
Dad, there are ducks on the lake!

Arabic: أَحْضَرْتُ خُبْزًا قَدِيمًا. هَلْ نُطْعِمُ الْبَطَّ؟
Transliteration: aḥḍartu khubzan qadiiman. hal nuṭʿimu l-baṭṭ?
English: I brought some old bread. Shall we feed the ducks?
Right. And after that we'll buy ice cream.

Arabic: أُمِّي! وَجَدْتُ قِطَّةً صَغِيرَةً عِنْدَ الْبَابِ.
Transliteration: ummii! wajadtu qiṭṭatan ṣaghiiratan ʿinda l-baab.
English: Mum! I found a little cat by the door.
Poor thing, she looks hungry and scared.
Shall we give her some food?

Arabic: نَعَمْ، ضَعِي لَهَا قَلِيلًا مِنَ الدَّجَاجِ وَصَحْنَ مَاءٍ.
Transliteration: naʿam, ḍaʿii lahaa qaliilan mina d-dajaaji wa-ṣaḥna maaʾ.
English: Yes, put out a little chicken and a bowl of water for her.

Arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تَبْقَى مَعَنَا؟ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَمِّيَهَا "مِشْمِش".
Transliteration: hal yumkinu an tabqaa maʿanaa? uriidu an usammiyahaa "mishmish".
English: Can she stay with us? I want to call her "Mishmish".

Arabic: سَنَسْأَلُ أَبَاكِ. لٰكِنْ إِنْ بَقِيَتْ، فَأَنْتِ تَعْتَنِينَ بِهَا.
Transliteration: sa-nasʾalu abaaki. laakin in baqiyat, fa-anti taʿtaniina bihaa.
English: We'll ask your dad. But if she stays, you look after her.

Arabic: أَعِدُكِ يَا أُمِّي! سَأُطْعِمُهَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
Transliteration: aʿiduki yaa ummii! sa-uṭʿimuhaa kulla yawm.
English: I promise, Mum! I'll feed her every day.

Arabic: أَبِي، اِنْقَطَعَتِ الْكَهْرَبَاءُ! كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مُظْلِمٌ.
Transliteration: abii, inqaṭaʿati l-kahrabaaʾ! kullu shayʾin muẓlim.
English: Dad, the power's gone off! Everything's dark.
Don't be scared. I'll switch on the phone's torch.
And here are some candles from the drawer.
It's hot, and the air conditioner isn't working!

Arabic: تَعَالَيْ نَجْلِسْ عَلَى الشُّرْفَةِ. هُنَاكَ نَسِيمٌ.
Transliteration: taʿaalay najlis ʿala sh-shurfa. hunaaka nasiim.
English: Come, let's sit on the balcony. There's a breeze.
And we'll play the shadow game on the wall.
Look, everyone, my hand has turned into a rabbit!

Arabic: سَارَةُ، سَيَأْتِي عَمُّكِ لِزِيَارَتِنَا بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍ.
Transliteration: saaratu, sa-yaʾtii ʿammuki li-ziyaaratinaa baʿda qaliil.
English: Sara, your uncle is coming to visit us soon.
Put the dates and sweets on the plates.

Arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ يَا عَمِّي! تَفَضَّلْ، أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا.
Transliteration: wa-ʿalaykumu s-salaamu yaa ʿammii! tafaḍḍal, ahlan wa-sahlan.
English: And peace be upon you, Uncle! Come in, welcome.

Arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ، كَبِرْتِ يَا سَارَةُ! كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟
Transliteration: maa shaaʾa llaah, kabirti yaa saaratu! kayfa ḥaaluki?
English: Ma sha Allah, you've grown, Sara! How are you?

Arabic: بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ. هَلْ تَشْرَبُ قَهْوَةً أَمْ شَايًا؟
Transliteration: bi-khayr, al-ḥamdu lillaah. hal tashrabu qahwatan am shaayan?
English: Fine, thank God. Would you like coffee or tea?

Arabic: سَارَةُ، هَيَّا نَكْتُبْ قَوَاعِدَ الْبَيْتِ مَعًا.
Transliteration: saaratu, hayyaa naktub qawaaʿida l-bayti maʿan.
English: Sara, let's write the house rules together.
Rule one: we say "please" and "thank you".

Arabic: مُمْتَازٌ. الثَّانِيَةُ: نُطْفِئُ الضَّوْءَ عِنْدَمَا نَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْغُرْفَةِ.
Transliteration: mumtaaz. ath-thaaniya: nuṭfiʾu ḍ-ḍawʾa ʿindamaa nakhruju mina l-ghurfa.
English: Excellent. Two: we switch off the light when we leave a room.
Three: we don't eat in front of the TV.
And four: everyone washes their own plate.

Arabic: هَا هَا، حَتَّى أَبُوكِ! الْقَوَاعِدُ لِلْجَمِيعِ.
Transliteration: haa haa, ḥattaa abuuki! al-qawaaʿidu li-l-jamiiʿ.
English: Ha ha, even your dad! The rules are for everyone.
I don't know… maybe the cat?

Arabic: الْقِطَّةُ نَائِمَةٌ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ مُنْذُ الصَّبَاحِ.
Transliteration: al-qiṭṭatu naaʾimatun fi l-ḥadiiqati mundhu ṣ-ṣabaaḥ.
English: The cat has been asleep in the garden since this morning.

Arabic: أُمِّي… أَنَا كَسَرْتُهَا وَأَنَا أَلْعَبُ بِالْكُرَةِ. أَنَا آسِفَةٌ.
Transliteration: ummii… ana kasartuhaa wa-ana alʿabu bi-l-kura. ana aasifa.
English: Mum… I broke it while I was playing with the ball. I'm sorry.

Arabic: أَنَا حَزِينَةٌ عَلَى الْمَزْهَرِيَّةِ، لٰكِنِّي سَعِيدَةٌ لِأَنَّكِ قُلْتِ الصِّدْقَ.
Transliteration: ana ḥaziinatun ʿala l-mazhariyya, laakinnii saʿiidatun li-annaki qulti ṣ-ṣidq.
English: I'm sad about the vase, but I'm glad you told the truth.

Arabic: لَنْ أَلْعَبَ بِالْكُرَةِ فِي الْبَيْتِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى.
Transliteration: lan alʿaba bi-l-kurati fi l-bayti marratan ukhraa.
English: I won't play ball in the house again.

Arabic: الصِّدْقُ أَهَمُّ مِنْ أَيِّ مَزْهَرِيَّةٍ. تَعَالَيْ نُنَظِّفِ الْمَكَانَ مَعًا.
Transliteration: aṣ-ṣidqu ahammu min ayyi mazhariyya. taʿaalay nunaẓẓifi l-makaana maʿan.
English: The truth matters more than any vase. Come, let's clean up together.
Ow! Mum, I cut my finger on the paper!

Arabic: تَعَالَيْ، أَرِينِي. الْجُرْحُ صَغِيرٌ، لَا تَقْلَقِي.
Transliteration: taʿaalay, ariinii. al-jurḥu ṣaghiir, laa taqlaqii.
English: Come and show me. It's a small cut, don't worry.

Arabic: سَنَغْسِلُهُ بِالْمَاءِ أَوَّلًا، ثُمَّ نَضَعُ الْمُطَهِّرَ.
Transliteration: sa-naghsiluhu bi-l-maaʾi awwalan, thumma naḍaʿu l-muṭahhir.
English: We'll wash it with water first, then put on antiseptic.

Arabic: قَلِيلًا فَقَطْ. وَالْآنَ لَاصِقَةٌ عَلَيْهَا نُجُومٌ!
Transliteration: qaliilan faqaṭ. wa-l-aana laaṣiqatun ʿalayhaa nujuum!
English: Just a little. And now a plaster with stars on it!

Arabic: أَبِي، أُمِّي فِي السَّرِيرِ. هَلْ هِيَ مَرِيضَةٌ؟
Transliteration: abii, ummii fi s-sariir. hal hiya mariiḍa?
English: Dad, Mum is in bed. Is she ill?

Arabic: عِنْدَهَا صُدَاعٌ وَزُكَامٌ. يَجِبُ أَنْ تَرْتَاحَ الْيَوْمَ.
Transliteration: ʿindahaa ṣudaaʿun wa-zukaam. yajibu an tartaaḥa l-yawm.
English: She has a headache and a cold. She needs to rest today.
Lovely idea. And I'll cook dinner.

Arabic: تَفَضَّلِي يَا أُمِّي. هَلْ تَشْعُرِينَ بِتَحَسُّنٍ؟
Transliteration: tafaḍḍalii yaa ummii. hal tashʿuriina bi-taḥassun?
English: Here you are, Mum. Are you feeling better?
Yes, when I see your lovely face.
Sleep now, and I'll play quietly.
